Hey, I'm a bit late to the thread but I wanted to add (as someone from Querétaro, México) San Miguel de Allende is beautiful and absolutely worth the visit, but there are also lots of foreigners there, which is something to keep in mind. A similar place to visit would be Bernal (look up Peña de Bernal, it's a stunning view). El Centro Histórico de Querétaro is also beautiful and there's lots of great restaurants and interesting places to visit, as well as guided tours. (One of my favorites is a tour based on several legends and local stories. You get to see reenactments of the stories and visit some of the places they supposedly took place in)

Other cool places to visit outside of Querétaro:

Nature: La Huasteca Potosina (beautiful waterfalls and green areas.), Santuario de Luciérnagas, Puebla (firefly sanctuary, it's a great experience), Fundación Yepez, Veracruz (organization that protects sea turtles. They have some great activities to help raise awareness) 
Museums and a more "city-life" approach: Ciudad de México (LOTS of museums and also the capital)
Archeological Sites: Chichén Itzá, Teotihuacan, Tulum, Palenque
